title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：literature　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 literature 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the scholar ① studied the literature that no student in the school would have recorded, and he said the studying was the whole of the year. The ② literature, meaning the story itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; literature, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of literature in that school had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ literature at the far shelf, meaning the page they kept for the children to read and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Literature, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the scholar said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the literature was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the story. The ⑥ literature, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; literature, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both story and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ literature had become a line in a syllabus, and the syllabus had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ literature of the whole thing, the scholar wrote in September, was one school and three years of recording; literature, he said, is either the page at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ literature I remember is the literature recorded in the syllabus, which closed in 1962 and is still recorded as the quietest in the school. ⑩ Literature, my mother said in 1964, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all literature, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like story. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 文学；文学作品（指学堂里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 文学；文学作品（指那种文学本身，与灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the literature 研读这些文学
D. n. 文学；文学作品（指留给孩子们读的那一页那一种）
E. n. 文章之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的文学之事）
F. n. 文学；文学作品（指书目里写到、被记载的的那一种）
G. n. 记忆、心声（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心声（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studied the literature that no student in the school would have recorded
The literature, meaning the story itself and not the lamp
Every kind of literature in that school
the literature at the far shelf
the literature was the whole of the matter
the literature had become a line in a syllabus
The literature of the whole thing

answers.why: study the literature 意为“研读这些文学”，1955 年那位学者把学堂里没有一位学生肯记载的一种文学做了一遍。
literature 意为“文学；文学作品”，指那种文学本身而不是灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
literature 意为“文学；文学作品”，指学堂里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
literature 意为“文学；文学作品”，指最远那排书架留给孩子们读的那一页那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
literature 意为“记忆、心声”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份记忆就是那件事的全部。
literature 意为“心声”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种文学，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
literature 意为“文学；文学作品”，指书目里写到、被记载的的那一种，到 1960 年这一种成了书目里的一行。
literature 意为“文章之事”，学者九月写道，整件事的文学之事是一处学堂和三个年头的记载。
literature 意为“文学；文学作品”，我记得的是书目里记载过的那一种，1962 年读完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一种。
literature 为抽象总称，母亲 1964 年说，文学是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的文学。
